requirements.text: * Approximately 2+ years of professional experience building and shipping production, consumer-facing applications with native iOS technologies.
* Proficiency in Swift and modern iOS development, including SwiftUI and Swift Concurrency.
* Experience using Xcode and the iOS SDK throughout the application-development lifecycle.
* Experience consuming REST APIs and integrating mobile features with backend services.
* Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows such as pull requests and code reviews.
* Ability to write testable, maintainable code using Swift Testing, XCTest, or similar tools.
* Solid debugging and code-quality fundamentals, including the ability to give and receive actionable code-review feedback.
* Clear, solution-oriented communication and a willingness to learn and collaborate in a cross-functional environment.
* An ownership mindset with the ability to deliver well-scoped work, surface risks, and follow through from implementation to launch validation.
This is a hybrid role based in Palo Alto, California, and requires in-office collaboration three times per week.
* Experience with UIKit, Objective-C, or Combine in an existing production codebase.
* Familiarity with modular iOS architectures or dependency-injection approaches, including MDI, MDUI, Nodes, or Needle.
* Experience with Bazel, Swift Package Manager, XCUITest, CI/CD pipelines, or mobile monitoring tools.
* Experience with experimentation platforms, product analytics, design systems, or feature-flagged releases.
* Experience building recommendation, discovery, personalization, social, messaging, marketplace, or other feature-rich consumer experiences at scale.
